en.p: Over all sequences $\{a_n\}$ whose terms are all integers and which satisfy the following conditions, find the sum of all possible values of $|a_1|$. [4 points]

box: $\qquad a_{n+1}=\begin{cases} a_n-3 & (\text{if } |a_n| \text{ is odd}) \\ \dfrac{1}{2}a_n & (\text{if } a_n=0 \text{ or } |a_n| \text{ is even}) \end{cases}$
(B) The minimum value of the natural number $m$ with $|a_m|=|a_{m+2}|$ is $3$.
